A common practice is to use mean squared error (MSE) as the reconstruction loss function, yet its induced optimization behavior remains largely unexplored. In this work, we take a holistic view of sequential quantization and systematically investigate how optimization evolves from the first quantization stage to the last, aiming for a deep understanding of optimization in learning-based PTQ schemes. Through extensive empirical studies spanning representative learning-based PTQ methods, LLM families, model scales, architectures, quantization settings and various tasks, we consistently uncover Optimization Imbalance: reconstruction loss magnitudes vary dramatically across stages, accompanied by highly uneven gradient magnitudes and parameter updates under MSE. We term the cross-stage range of loss magnitudes the reconstruction loss scale, and reveal that MSE translates the unexpectedly large reconstruction loss scale into highly uneven gradient magnitudes, which in turn lead to uneven optimization strength across quantization stages. This finding suggests a general principle for improving learning-based PTQ: optimization strength across stages should be decoupled from the reconstruction loss scale. Theoretically, we show that root mean squared error (RMSE) variants defined at the sample, channel, token, and element levels naturally realize this principle through implicit gradient normalization, outperforming MSE significantly as a drop-in replacement.
articles.titleCn: 魔鬼藏在重建损失尺度中：重新思考LLM量化的优化
articles.abstractCn: 训练后量化（PTQ）方法通常采用顺序量化，将预训练的大型语言模型（LLM）划分为一系列单元（例如Transformer模块），每个阶段量化一个单元。最先进的PTQ方法主要是基于学习的，通过梯度下降优化辅助量化参数（例如缩放因子、旋转矩阵、裁剪阈值和适配器），以最小化重建损失。常见的做法是使用均方误差（MSE）作为重建损失函数，但其诱导的优化行为仍基本未得到探索。在本工作中，我们全面审视顺序量化，系统地研究了优化如何从第一个量化阶段演变为最后一个阶段，旨在深入理解基于学习的PTQ方案中的优化过程。通过涵盖代表性的基于学习的PTQ方法、LLM系列、模型规模、架构、量化设置和多种任务的广泛实证研究，我们一致发现优化不平衡现象：重建损失幅度在不同阶段差异巨大，伴随着MSE下梯度幅度和参数更新的高度不均衡。我们将跨阶段的损失幅度范围称为重建损失尺度，并揭示MSE将意外大的重建损失尺度转化为高度不均衡的梯度幅度，进而导致量化阶段优化强度的不均衡。这一发现为改进基于学习的PTQ提供了一个普遍原则：各阶段的优化强度应与重建损失尺度解耦。理论上，我们证明在样本、通道、token和元素级别定义的均方根误差（RMSE）变体通过隐式梯度归一化自然地实现了这一原则，作为MSE的即插即用替代方案，性能显著优于MSE。

articles.title: A Citation-Grounded Benchmark for Trustworthy Earnings Call Transcript Analysis with Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have been increasingly used for financial document analysis, including earnings call transcripts (ECTs). Beyond generating standalone claims, users increasingly prefer grounded analyses that pair claims with verifiable citations from source documents to enable independent validation. However, evaluating such analytical claims typically requires extensive expert annotation, which is costly and difficult to scale, and real-world financial analysis commonly involves long context-question-answer triplets, further increasing task complexity. To address these challenges and benchmark the current landscape of grounded analysis by LLMs, we propose a numeric evidence evaluation method that enables groundedness assessment without reliance on expert annotation. We also introduce an automated dataset construction pipeline and construct ECTs-100 from the top 100 constituents of the S&P 500 to support benchmark of both groundedness and correctness. In addition, we examine conscious incompetence, a practical failure mode in financial analysis in which LLMs must detect when available evidence is insufficient and refrain from producing unsupported hallucinations. Empirical results show that LLMs perform well in groundedness but face notable limitations in correctness, with informational insufficiency presenting an additional challenge.
articles.titleCn: 基于引文的可信财报电话会议文本分析基准，使用大型语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在金融文档分析中的应用日益广泛，包括收益电话会议记录（ECTs）。除了生成独立的声明外，用户越来越倾向于与可验证的来源文档引用相结合的基于证据的分析，以实现独立验证。然而，评估此类分析性声明通常需要大量的专家标注，这既昂贵又难以扩展，而现实中的金融分析通常涉及长上下文-问题-答案三元组，进一步增加了任务的复杂性。为了应对这些挑战并评估LLMs在基于证据分析方面的现状，我们提出了一种数值证据评估方法，该方法能够在不依赖专家标注的情况下进行基于证据性评估。我们还引入了一个自动化的数据集构建流程，并从标普500指数的前100个成分股中构建了ECTs-100数据集，以支持基于证据性和正确性的基准测试。此外，我们考察了无意识的无能（conscious incompetence），这是一种金融分析中的实际失效模式，其中LLMs必须检测到可用证据不足，并避免产生未经支持的自发幻觉。实证结果表明，LLMs在基于证据性方面表现良好，但在正确性方面面临显著限制，信息不足构成了额外的挑战。

articles.title: RPTune: Learned Context Curation for LLM Catalog Search
articles.abstract: For small merchant businesses (SMBs) whose catalogs fit within a long-context LLM, full-catalog prompting offers a compelling alternative to multi-stage retrieval designed primarily for large marketplaces with millions of items. However, fitting the full catalog into the context window does not ensure that the model can use it effectively, since LLMs do not exploit long contexts uniformly. We therefore study in-context catalog search through two complementary questions: (1) how to curate and present catalogs to the LLM, and (2) how to adapt the LLM for product selection on curated contexts. We propose RPTune, an end-to-end framework that couples learned catalog curation with LLM post-training using automatically generated, catalog-grounded supervision. An encoder-reorganizer curator orders and prunes products guided by downstream LLM feedback, while the resulting curated catalogs in turn improve the effectiveness of LLM post-training with a context-relative reward. We evaluate RPTune on 7 real merchants spanning distinct retail verticals, using 100 complex conversational queries per merchant. RPTune consistently improves search accuracy across both proprietary and open-weight LLMs, with context curation yielding gains of up to 31.4 percentage points and post-training adding a further 10.3 points on average.
articles.titleCn: RPTune：用于LLM目录搜索的学习型上下文筛选
articles.abstractCn: 对于目录适合于长上下文大型语言模型（LLM）的小型商家企业（SMB），全目录提示提供了一种优于主要为包含数百万商品的巨大市场设计的多阶段检索的吸引人替代方案。然而，将全目录放入上下文窗口并不能保证模型能有效利用它，因为大型语言模型并不均匀地利用长上下文。因此，我们通过两个互补的问题研究上下文目录搜索：（1）如何策展并向LLM展示目录，以及（2）如何调整LLM以在策展的上下文中进行产品选择。我们提出了RPTune，这是一个端到端框架，它结合了通过自动生成的、基于目录的监督进行学习的目录策展和LLM的后续训练。编码器重组策展者根据下游LLM的反馈对产品进行排序和修剪，而由此产生的策展目录反过来又通过相对上下文的奖励提高了LLM后续训练的有效性。我们在7家涵盖不同零售垂直领域的真实商家上评估了RPTune，每个商家使用100个复杂的对话查询。RPTune在专有和开放权重LLM上始终提高了搜索准确率，其中上下文策展带来了高达31.4个百分点的收益，后续训练平均再增加了10.3个百分点。

articles.title: Role-aware Heuristic Episodic Attention for Conversational LLMs
articles.abstract: Large language models often lose track of persistent instructions and relevant information as multi-turn conversations grow. We study this cumulative contextual decay through three related failure modes: attention pollution, dilution, and drift. We propose REA (Role-aware Heuristic Episodic Attention), a context-management framework that assigns different persistence and representation policies to instructions and episodic interactions. Instructional Memory retains identified global constraints in a dedicated prefix. Episodic Memory preserves user inputs and compresses model replies, while heuristic retrieval selects raw text, compressed representations, or omission for each historical turn. On Long-MT-Bench+, REA improves the judge score from 6.32 to 7.36 on a 10-point scale, a 16.5% relative gain over the Vanilla baseline, and reduces average latency by 2.91$\times$. Additional evaluations show aggregate gains on three backbones spanning 1.7B-7B parameters and on Chinese and English role-playing tasks. These results support role-aware context management as a practical approach to maintaining conversational continuity and instruction adherence.
articles.titleCn: 角色感知启发式情景注意力机制用于对话式大型语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型在多轮对话中往往会逐渐遗忘持续指令和相关信息。我们通过三种相关的失效模式——注意力污染、稀释和漂移——来研究这种累积性上下文衰减现象。我们提出了REA（角色感知启发式情景注意力），这是一种上下文管理框架，为指令和情景交互分配不同的持久性和表示策略。指令记忆器在一个专用前缀中保留已识别的全局约束。情景记忆器保存用户输入并压缩模型回复，而启发式检索则针对每轮历史交互选择原始文本、压缩表示或省略。在Long-MT-Bench+上，REA将评分从6.32提升至7.36（满分10分），相较于Vanilla基线实现了16.5%的相对增益，并将平均延迟降低了2.91倍。额外评估显示，在涵盖1.7B-7B参数范围的三种主干架构以及中文和英文角色扮演任务上均取得了综合增益。这些结果支持角色感知上下文管理作为一种实用方法，有助于维持对话连续性和指令一致性。

articles.title: Beyond Leaderboards: Tokenomics of Agentic Small Language Model Ensembles
articles.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) move from standalone assistants into agentic workflows, evaluation must extend beyond scalar leaderboard accuracy to account for operational reliability, cost, latency, and token efficiency. We use an agentic ensemble of small language models (SLMs) with an SLM-judge-mediated feedback loop as a case study for such beyond-leaderboard evaluation. On the 541-prompt IFEval benchmark, the best ensemble achieves 97.34% strict prompt accuracy, exceeding the strongest standalone LLM baseline, gpt-5.4, by 5.81 percentage points while operating in a lower-cost regime. We then analyze the tokenomics and operational behavior behind this gain, including cost per sample, token composition, useful-output goodput, feedback-loop recovery, latency decomposition, and performance across instruction categories and constraint counts. Our results show that agentic SLM ensembles can trade additional test-time tokens and orchestration overhead for improved instruction-following fidelity, motivating multi-dimensional evaluation protocols for future agentic AI systems.
articles.comment: 8 pages, 9 figures, Presented at ACM CAIS 2026 Workshop RLEval: Methods and Reinforcement Learning Environments for Evaluating AI Agents. Resubmission of permitted appeal, Ticket #MOD-104177
articles.titleCn: 超越排行榜：自主小型语言模型集群的代币经济学
articles.abstractCn: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）从独立助手转向代理式工作流程，评估必须超越排行榜上的标量准确率，以涵盖运营可靠性、成本、延迟和令牌效率。我们以小型语言模型（SLMs）的代理式集成，并辅以SLM裁判介导的反馈循环，作为此类排行榜外评估的案例研究。在541条提示的IFEval基准测试中，最佳集成达到了97.34%的严格提示准确率，在成本较低的环境下，比最强的独立式LLM基线gpt-5.4高出5.81个百分点。随后，我们分析了这一提升背后的令牌经济和运营行为，包括每样本成本、令牌构成、有用输出吞吐量、反馈循环恢复、延迟分解以及在指令类别和约束计数上的性能。我们的结果表明，代理式SLM集成可以通过增加测试时令牌和协调开销来换取更高的指令遵循保真度，从而为未来代理式AI系统推动多维度的评估协议。

articles.title: ReHoPER: Receding-Horizon Planning for Enhanced Reasoning
articles.abstract: We propose ReHoPER, an inference-only, zero-shot method that improves large language models' reasoning by generating and answering intermediate questions along multiple paths before the final answer. It iteratively plans a horizon of candidate intermediate questions, selects one to answer, and replans from the updated history. ReHoPER is task-agnostic, using the same generic instructions across datasets and models without labeled data or task-specific prompt design. Across multiple datasets, including iLLC, a new controlled benchmark for compositional reasoning, ReHoPER outperforms strong baselines, with the largest gains in the most compositional settings. Our implementation and the iLLC generator are publicly available to support future work.
articles.titleCn: ReHoPER：增强推理的回退地平线规划
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了ReHoPER，一种仅用于推理、零样本的方法，通过在最终答案之前沿多条路径生成和回答中间问题来提升大型语言模型的推理能力。ReHoPER迭代地规划一系列候选中间问题，选择其中一个进行回答，并从更新后的历史记录中重新规划。ReHoPER是任务无关的，在多个数据集和模型中使用相同的通用指令，无需标记数据或特定任务的提示设计。在包括iLLC在内的多个数据集上，iLLC是一个新的用于组合推理的控制基准，ReHoPER优于强大的基线模型，在最具组合性的设置中取得了最大的提升。我们的实现和iLLC生成器已公开发布，以支持未来的研究工作。

articles.title: Efficient Task Adaptation in Large Language Models: A Survey of Weight-Based, Prompt-Based, and Embedding-Based Adaptations
articles.abstract: As large language models are increasingly deployed across diverse downstream tasks, efficient task adaptation has emerged as a central challenge. In response, a wide range of task adaptation methods have been proposed, spanning parameter-efficient fine-tuning, in-context learning, and embedding-injection approaches. However, these lines of work have largely evolved within individual paradigms, leaving their cross-paradigm relationships and trade-offs underexplored, especially for recently emerging embedding-based adaptations. This survey presents a unified framework that categorizes task adaptation methods by where and how task information is encoded: model weights, input prompts, or injected task embeddings. We provide a comprehensive taxonomy that integrates these paradigms, analyze their key strengths and limitations to explain how different adaptation paradigms have evolved, clarify relationships across paradigms, and highlight open problems for future research.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型中的高效任务自适应：基于权重、提示和嵌入的自适应方法综述
articles.abstractCn: 随着大型语言模型越来越多地应用于各种下游任务，高效的任务适应已成为一个核心挑战。为此，人们提出了广泛的任务适应方法，涵盖参数高效微调、情境学习以及嵌入注入方法。然而，这些工作在很大程度上是在各自的范式内发展起来的，其跨范式关系和权衡尚未得到充分探索，特别是对于最近出现的基于嵌入的适应方法。本综述提出了一种统一框架，根据任务信息编码的位置和方式对任务适应方法进行分类：模型权重、输入提示或注入的任务嵌入。我们提供了一个综合分类体系，将这些范式整合起来，分析它们的关键优势和局限性，以解释不同适应范式是如何演变的，阐明范式之间的关系，并突出未来研究中的开放问题。

articles.title: The Geometry of Contextual Relations: Language Models Address Facts by Order of Mention
articles.abstract: Human reasoning depends on how objects are related within propositions. \textit{How do relations organize the language representations of contextual contents?} We give an LLM a list of facts in its context (e.g., \emph{Alice eats an apple. Bob eats a pear.}) and measure how its hidden state changes when the question switches from what Alice eats to what Bob eats. Averaged over many lists, this change is a steering vector, which we call the \emph{ordinal vector}. It points to a fact by its \emph{order of mention}, the order in which the facts were stated in the context. We find that LLMs represent the fact a question asks about by its order of mention, not by the name the question contains. We state this as the \textit{ordinal addressing hypothesis}: each order of mention has a \emph{fact address} in the model's state, shared by all contexts, and a question moves the state to the fact address of the fact it asks about, while the context supplies what that fact says. Across Qwen, Gemma, and Llama, fact addresses are (1) \emph{ordered by mention}: query states are organized by the order of facts, not of names, even when one fact has multiple subjects; (2) \emph{steerable}: added to a question about the first fact of a new list, the ordinal vector makes the model answer with the second fact of that list; (3) \emph{low-rank}: they span a low-rank subspace in which the first-mentioned fact is the easiest to reach, surprisingly similar to human recall; and (4) \emph{emergent}: they are shared in late-middle layers, hold from 1.5B to 32B parameters, and form early in pretraining. Language models reach a stated fact by where it was mentioned, deepening our understanding of LLM reasoning.
articles.titleCn: 情境关系的几何学：语言模型按提及顺序处理事实
articles.abstractCn: 人类推理依赖于命题中对象之间的关系。**关系如何组织上下文内容的语言表示？** 我们向大型语言模型提供其上下文中的一系列事实（例如，\emph{Alice吃了一个苹果。Bob吃了一个梨。}），并测量当问题从Alice吃什么切换到Bob吃什么时其隐藏状态的变化。在许多列表上取平均值，这种变化是一个导向向量，我们称之为\emph{序向量}。它通过事实的\emph{提及顺序}指向该事实，即事实在上下文中被陈述的顺序。我们发现，大型语言模型通过事实的提及顺序来表示问题所询问的事实，而不是问题中包含的名称。我们将此表述为\textit{序地址假设}：每个提及顺序在模型的态中都有一个\emph{事实地址}，该地址在所有上下文中共享，而问题将态移动到它所询问的事实的地址，同时上下文提供该事实的内容。在Qwen、Gemma和Llama中，事实地址具有以下特征：(1) \emph{按提及顺序排列}：查询态按事实的顺序组织，而不是按名称的顺序，即使一个事实有多个主语；(2) \emph{可导向}：在关于新列表中第一个事实的问题中添加序向量，使模型回答该列表中的第二个事实；(3) \emph{低秩}：它们在一个低秩子空间中张成，其中首次提及的事实最容易到达，出人意料地类似于人类回忆；(4) \emph{涌现}：它们在后期中间层共享，参数规模从1.5B到32B，并在预训练早期形成。语言模型通过提及的位置来获取所述事实，加深了我们对大型语言模型推理的理解。

articles.title: ActiveSaddler: Automated Curriculum Learning for Agent Harness Optimization
articles.abstract: Automated harness optimization can substantially improve LLM agents by iteratively updating their prompts, tool interfaces, and control logic from execution feedback. However, existing methods primarily optimize how the harness is updated while largely fixing which training scenarios generate the feedback that drives those updates. As the harness evolves, the scenarios most useful for further optimization can change, suggesting that the training curriculum itself should adapt alongside the harness. We formulate this missing dimension of harness optimization as an automated curriculum learning problem and introduce ActiveSaddler. ActiveSaddler models the evolving curriculum as a non-stationary bandit with dynamically instantiated optimization targets. It abstracts recurring failures into reusable failure-pattern arms, estimates the potential learning progress from further targeting each pattern, and adaptively balances revisiting known weaknesses with exploring unseen scenarios for new ones. Optimization outcomes continually update both the set of discovered failure patterns and their priorities, allowing the curriculum to co-evolve with the harness. Experiments on GAIA2 and Terminal-Bench 2.0 show that ActiveSaddler consistently discovers stronger harnesses, improving test Pass@1 by 4.4 and 7.5 percentage points over the same harness optimizer using a scenario order fixed before optimization, respectively. Ablations further show that these gains depend on dynamically constructing optimization targets, estimating their evolving utility, and balancing continued optimization with new failure discovery. Together, these results establish automated curriculum learning as a new crucial optimization dimension for harness optimization.
articles.comment: 37 pages, 16 figures. Project website and code: https://autosaddler-projectpage.github.io/activesaddler/
articles.titleCn: ActiveSaddler：智能体适配器优化的自动化课程学习
articles.abstractCn: 自动化套件优化能够显著提升大语言模型代理，通过从执行反馈中迭代更新其提示、工具接口和控制逻辑。然而，现有方法主要优化套件更新的方式，而很大程度上固定了哪些训练场景生成驱动更新的反馈。随着套件的演进，对进一步优化最有用的场景可能会改变，这表明训练课程本身也应与套件同步适应。我们将套件优化中缺失的维度表述为一个自动化课程学习问题，并引入了ActiveSaddler。ActiveSaddler将演进的课程建模为具有动态实例化优化目标的非平稳 bandit。它将反复出现的失败抽象为可重用的失败模式臂，估计从进一步针对每个模式中潜在的学习进展，并自适应地平衡重访已知弱点与探索未见过的场景以发现新的弱点。优化结果持续更新已发现的失败模式及其优先级，使课程与套件共同演进。在GAIA2和Terminal-Bench 2.0上的实验表明，ActiveSaddler始终能发现更强的套件，分别比在优化前固定场景顺序的相同套件优化器提高了4.4和7.5个百分点的测试Pass@1。消融实验进一步表明，这些提升依赖于动态构建优化目标、估计其演化效用，以及在持续优化与发现新失败之间进行平衡。这些结果共同确立了自动化课程学习作为套件优化中一个新的关键优化维度。

articles.title: DeBERTa-ConPara: Attack-Aware and Deployment-Realistic Detection of AI-Generated Text
articles.abstract: Robust detection of AI-generated text under deployment conditions is challenging: distribution shifts across domains and generators, adversarial perturbations of the input surface, and the absence of target-domain labels for threshold calibration all degrade detectors that perform well in-domain. We present DeBERTa-ConPara, a deployment-oriented detector combining attack-aware Unicode preprocessing with a contextual transformer encoder trained over HC3 Plus, M4, MAGE and RAID. Our central finding is that preprocessing acts in opposite directions depending on where it is applied: normalising the training corpus deduplicates it, collapsing 35.4% of RAID rows into copies of their clean siblings and deleting the adversarial supervision, whereas normalising at inference is an effective defence. A factorial varying the two placements independently identifies raw training with normalised inference as the best configuration, reaching 99.61% AUROC, 99.01% TPR@5% FPR and 96.57% TPR@1% FPR on the official RAID hidden test, alongside 93.14% average balanced accuracy across HC3 Plus and MAGE under a fixed threshold. The gain is confined to two of twelve attack classes: homoglyph and zero-width-space insertion rise from 11.05% and 1.12% to 96.98%. The same signature reproduces in a zero-shot detector of different architecture, showing the effect belongs to the attacks rather than to our model. We additionally report two negative results: semantic-invariance augmentation through paraphrasing and supervised contrastive learning (ConPara) does not improve the best configuration, and the handcrafted feature-fusion branch is inert in distribution and harmful outside it.
articles.comment: Accepted at AACL-IJCNLP 2026 (main conference). 9 pages plus appendix. Code and checkpoint: https://github.com/MohamedMady19/deberta-conpara, https://huggingface.co/mohamedmady/deberta-conpara
articles.titleCn: DeBERTa-ConPara：针对攻击和部署现实的AI生成文本检测
articles.abstractCn: 在部署条件下对AI生成的文本进行稳健检测极具挑战性：领域和生成器之间的分布偏移、输入表面的对抗性扰动，以及缺乏目标领域标签进行阈值校准，都会降低在领域内表现良好的检测器的性能。我们提出了DeBERTa-ConPara，这是一种面向部署的检测器，它结合了攻击感知的Unicode预处理和在一个涵盖HC3 Plus、M4、MAGE和RAID的数据集上训练的上下文Transformer编码器。我们的核心发现是，预处理的作用方向取决于其应用位置：对训练语料库进行标准化会使其去重，将35.4%的RAID行合并为其干净副本，并删除对抗性监督，而推理时的标准化则是一种有效的防御措施。通过独立改变这两种位置的因子实验确定了原始训练与标准化推理的最佳配置，在官方RAID隐藏测试集上达到了99.61%的AUROC、99.01%的TPR@5% FPR和96.57%的TPR@1% FPR，同时在HC3 Plus和MAGE上以固定阈值为基准实现了93.14%的平均平衡精度。这种提升仅限于12种攻击类别中的两种：同形字插入和零宽空格插入的检测准确率从11.05%和1.12%提升至96.98%。相同的特征模式在一个不同架构的零样本检测器中重现，表明这种效果属于攻击本身而非我们的模型。此外，我们还报告了两个负面结果：通过释义和监督对比学习（ConPara）实现的语义不变性增强并未改善最佳配置，而手工特征融合分支在分布内无效且在其外有害。

articles.title: Kinematic MeanFlow: One-Step Action Generation Policy for Robotic Foundation Models
articles.abstract: In this paper, we study how to achieve one-step action generation in Robotic Foundation Models (RFMs), aiming to overcome the high inference latency of multi-step flow matching. MeanFlow provides a promising framework for this goal, yet its direct application leads to performance collapse. We discover that this stems from two distinctive dynamics exhibited in the RFM velocity field: (1) the ``local acceleration" exhibits stability early on, but surges sharply towards the end of the denoising process, and (2) the spread of its magnitudes across samples widens as denoising progresses. To address these issues, we introduce Kinematic MeanFlow (K-MF), a novel one-step action policy tailored for RFMs. Specifically, grounded in a kinematic identity, K-MF decouples the time derivative term in the MeanFlow formulation into two sub-interval terms separated by an intermediate point. This decoupled formulation enables the two terms to capture early-stage and late-stage denoising dynamics, respectively, while mitigating the error amplification across the process. As a result, our K-MF empowers RFMs to achieve one-step action generation in both training from scratch and fine-tuning paradigms across diverse tasks, while outperforming multi-step flow matching in most settings. In terms of inference efficiency, K-MF reduces action-head latency of GR00T-N1.6 by 67.5%~74.4% across L40 and Jetson Orin in eager and compiled modes, yielding end-to-end latency reductions of 30.3%~54.9%. Code will be available at https://github.com/IntelChina-AI/K-MF.
articles.titleCn: 运动学平均流：机器人基础模型的一步动作生成策略
articles.abstractCn: 在本文中，我们研究了如何在机器人基础模型（RFMs）中实现单步动作生成，旨在克服多步流匹配的高推理延迟。MeanFlow为这一目标提供了一个有前景的框架，但其直接应用会导致性能崩溃。我们发现这源于RFM速度场中表现出的两种独特动态：（1）“局部加速度”在去噪过程的早期表现出稳定性，但在去噪过程的末尾急剧增加；（2）其幅值在样本间的分布随着去噪过程的进行而扩大。为了解决这些问题，我们引入了运动学MeanFlow（K-MF），这是一种专为RFMs设计的新型单步动作策略。具体而言，基于一个运动学恒等式，K-MF将MeanFlow公式中的时间导数项分解为两个由中间点分隔的子区间项。这种分解后的公式使两个子区间项分别捕捉早期和晚期的去噪动态，同时减轻了过程中的误差放大。因此，我们的K-MF使RFMs能够在各种任务中从零开始训练和微调范式下实现单步动作生成，并在大多数情况下优于多步流匹配。在推理效率方面，K-MF将GR00T-N1.6在L40和Jetson Orin上的动作头延迟降低了67.5%~74.4%（在eager和编译模式下），从而将端到端延迟降低了30.3%~54.9%。代码将在https://github.com/IntelChina-AI/K-MF上提供。

articles.title: Child-Adapted Structured Phonological Representations for Interpretable Speech Sound Analysis
articles.abstract: Structured phonological representations provide an interpretable alternative to generic speech embeddings, but existing models are largely trained on adult speech. We adapt PhonoQ-2.0 to child speech using CHILDES-Aligned data and compare three alignment-supervision conditions (Adult, Adult+Child, and Child-only) across two initialization strategies (Adult PhonoQ and scratch). Generalization is evaluated against manual child-speech annotations. On 1,352 consonant targets from 58 typically developing children, child-speech adaptation improves voicing recognition across all supervision conditions, from 0.922 macro-F1 for Adult PhonoQ to 0.972--0.987 after adaptation. Manner is more sensitive to alignment supervision: Adult+Child MFA reaches 0.804 and 0.796, compared to approximately 0.70 under Adult MFA supervision. Place remains comparatively strong across systems (0.871--0.902), although per-class performance varies substantially. The velar-fronting contrast is preserved across all seven model variants. Longitudinal UltraPhonix analysis further reveals speaker-specific velar and post-alveolar changes that are largely preserved across models and broadly consistent with reported clinical progress.
articles.titleCn: 儿童适应性结构语音表征，用于可解释的语音声学分析
articles.abstractCn: 结构化语音表征为通用语音嵌入提供了一种可解释的替代方案，但现有模型大多在成人语音上训练。我们使用CHILDES-Aligned数据将PhonoQ-2.0适配于儿童语音，并在两种初始化策略（成人PhonoQ和从头开始训练）下，比较了三种对齐监督条件（成人、成人+儿童和仅儿童）的性能。泛化效果通过手动儿童语音标注进行评估。在58名典型发育儿童提供的1,352个辅音目标上，儿童语音适配在所有监督条件下均提升了浊音识别率，从成人PhonoQ的0.922宏观F1提升至适配后的0.972-0.987。方式特征对对齐监督更为敏感：成人+儿童MFA达到0.804和0.796，而成人MFA监督下约为0.70。位置特征在所有系统中的表现相对稳定（0.871-0.902），尽管各类别的性能差异显著。软腭-前移对比在所有七个模型变体中均得以保留。纵向UltraPhonix分析进一步揭示了特定说话人的软腭和齿龈后音变化，这些变化在模型中基本得到保留，并与已报告的临床进展大体一致。

articles.title: AuraForge: Scaling Security Supervision for Training Coding Agents
articles.abstract: Coding agents are now proficient enough to generate complex software applications from a single prompt. As their capabilities have grown, human oversight has increasingly shifted from line-by-line code review toward hands-off evaluation of outcomes. However, recent studies have shown that such a transition exposes a critical risk: functional correctness alone does not guarantee a secure implementation. Despite growing attention to code security, training safer coding agents remains challenging because reliable security supervision is difficult to obtain at scale from real-world repositories. We introduce AuraForge to synthesize and validate executable security tests for training secure coding agents. Our approach combines attack-oriented test synthesis, language-extensible task construction, and safeguards against reward hacking. Using AuraForge, we construct AuraGym, a multi-language and multi-CWE executable training gym: 679 executable feature-implementation tasks from 344 real-world repositories across Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript, covering 177 CWE categories. On the subset with human-written security tests, AuraForge produces about 3 times as many test cases on average and reduces the false-positive rate by 83.23%, allowing alternative secure implementations to receive correct supervision. Training Qwen3.5-4B with synthesized security tests gains larger improvements than human-written security tests (average 19.7 FuncPass and 6.2 SecPass vs. 14.9 FuncPass and 4.4 SecPass) on three languages. These results demonstrate that AuraForge provides more diverse and reliable security supervision to train secure coding agents.
articles.titleCn: AuraForge：扩展安全监督以训练编码代理
articles.abstractCn: 编码代理现在已经足够熟练，能够根据单个提示生成复杂的软件应用程序。随着其能力的增长，人类监督逐渐从逐行代码审查转向对结果的放手评估。然而，最近的研究表明，这种转变暴露了一个关键风险：仅功能性正确并不能保证安全实现。尽管对代码安全的关注日益增加，但训练更安全的编码代理仍然具有挑战性，因为从现实世界的代码库中大规模获取可靠的监督仍然很困难。我们介绍了AuraForge，用于合成和验证可执行的测试，以训练安全的编码代理。我们的方法结合了面向攻击的测试合成、语言可扩展的任务构建以及防止奖励攻击的保障措施。使用AuraForge，我们构建了AuraGym，这是一个多语言和多CWE可执行训练环境：从Python、JavaScript和TypeScript的344个现实世界代码库中提取了679个可执行的功能实现任务，涵盖了177个CWE类别。在包含人类编写的安全测试的子集上，AuraForge平均生成的测试用例数量约为3倍，并将误报率降低了83.23%，从而允许替代的安全实现获得正确的监督。使用合成的安全测试训练Qwen3.5-4B，在三种语言上获得的改进大于人类编写的安全测试（平均19.7 FuncPass和6.2 SecPass，对比14.9 FuncPass和4.4 SecPass）。这些结果表明，AuraForge为训练安全的编码代理提供了更多样化和可靠的监督。
